Package dayplanner

Class Activity

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Activity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Activity>
Direct Known Subclasses:
HomeActivity, OtherActivity, SchoolActivity
public class Activity extends Object implements Comparable<Activity>
Superclass for all types of Activities. Contains all shared attributes and methods. Activities must contain titles, start and end times. Optionally, activities can contain comments.

    • toRAS

      public String toRAS()
      Encodes this instance into RAS (Readable Activity Serial), a text format that allows it to be written to text files. RAS entries are surrounded by angle brackets, and split into columns separated by commas:
      • A String denoting the activity type.
      • A String denoting the activity title.
      • String representation of the start and end times.
      • A String denoting the comment, or NIL if there is no comment.
      • For OtherActivities, a String denoting the location.
      For more details, see ActivityList.toRAS() or README.md.
      Returns:
      A RAS representation of this Activity.

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Activity other)
      Compare two Activity instances by starting time.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Activity>
      Parameters:
      other - The other Activity to compare with.
      Returns:
      An integer indicating the relationship between the two instances: A value of 0 indicates they start at the same time; a negative value indicates the calling Activity precedes the argument; and a positive value indicates the calling Activity follows the argument.
